# Project 26: YouTube Learning Vault

**Category:** 4. Learning, Research & Knowledge
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 26`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Saves educational videos and organizes their transcripts, timestamps and key lessons.

> Original: Educational videos ko save karke transcripts, timestamps aur key lessons organize karta hai.

### Core features

- Video library
- Chapter notes
- Searchable takeaways
